titles.romaji: Tori vs. Buta: Buttobi Pizza Battle
titles.native: トリvsブタ ぶっとびピザバトル

description: A Domino's Japan commercial promoting their new summer pizzas which have four meat styles on a single pizza. The commercial itself is a battle of the bands style competition ballad between the chicken pizza and pork pizza.
